rulesStrings.li: questDescription->A nearby Foundation sector has lost containment of SCP-106. This assignment unlocks a 300-point chamber research project. Research it, prepare an empty powered containment chamber, then activate the Larry return protocol and choose a colonist or prisoner as bait. The bait will remain inside. SCP-106 appears after loading, approaches slowly and can pass through walls with a delay. Once it reaches the chamber, it is contained and the bait dies.

li.label: SCP-106 contained
li.text: SCP-106 entered the prepared chamber. The bait died during containment.

li.label: SCP-106 lost
li.text: SCP-106 has left the map without being contained. The Foundation may try another recovery operation.
